[[Andorra]] competed at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]] in [[Barcelona]], Spain. Eight competitors, seven men and one woman, took part in five events in five sports.<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/summer/1992/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417093551/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/summer/1992/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |title=Andorra at the 1992 Summer Games |access-date=19 July 2016 |work=Sports Reference}}</ref>
